description: This file is a shell script used to manage the lifecycle of a service named 'cosa' within a larger system. It includes functions to start, stop, restart, and report the status of the service, as well as handling registration, logging, and process management.

methods.name: cosa_start
methods.description: Changes directory to /usr/ccsp and executes the cosa_start.sh script in background to initiate the service.

methods.name: service_start
methods.description: Handles starting the 'cosa' service: updates status, calls cosa_start, and manages error checking.

methods.name: service_stop
methods.description: Handles stopping the 'cosa' service: kills related processes, updates status, and manages error checking.
